# Support — Sonic Purity

Published at <https://ardathepolatserve.github.io/sonicpurity-support/>

**Do not edit `index.html` by hand.** It is generated from
`docs/legal/support.md` in the Sonic Purity app repository by
`scripts/publish_legal.py`, so that the published page and the copy the
app ships cannot drift apart. Edit the markdown there and re-run it.
